theater: 西沙群島永樂群島甘泉、珊瑚外海

battle.name: 西沙之戰
battle.theater: 西沙群島永樂群島甘泉、珊瑚外海
battle.brief: 一九七四年一月十九日至二十日，南海艦隊在永樂群島同南越海軍打短促海戰，四艘美製軍艦在甘泉、珊瑚外海被中方獵潛與掃雷艦咬住，一艦沉沒，中方次日登陸甘泉、珊瑚、金銀三島。卡面051型導彈驅逐艦是編隊裡唯一的導彈重火力平臺，駐守外海做警戒護航，近程纏鬥則交畀排水量遠小於它的小艇。

kit.name: 051型導彈驅逐艦
kit.history: 051型是中國人民解放軍海軍水面艦艇部隊的導彈驅逐艦，執行編隊防空、反艦、警戒與護航，是早期海上防空作戰體系的骨幹。

countries: 這是兩個執政體在同一片島礁上直接交手的短促海戰。中方是中華人民共和國海軍南海艦隊，作戰指揮實際落在海南崖縣的榆林海軍基地：一月十四日南海艦隊令基地組織自一九五九年三月以來的第七十七次西沙巡邏；十六日中央軍委決定全體行動統一由廣州軍區（司令員許世友）指揮，並在榆林基地成立作戰指揮班子。海上編隊以一艘051型導彈驅逐艦為核心，配6604型獵潛艇、6610型掃雷艦、037型獵潛艇與護衛艇，按中方公開戰史常列的數字共出動艦艇十九艘、兵力約二千七百餘人；陸戰力量為守備第一百五十團與要塞區直屬兩棲偵察隊組成的加強營，另有西南中沙人武部數個排武裝民兵進駐晉卿、琛航等島。越方是越南共和國海軍的西沙特遣隊，靠美軍移交的艦艇重建：HQ-5「陳平仲」為旗艦、HQ-16「李常傑」、HQ-4「陳慶餘」、HQ-10「日早」四艘美製軍艦，另有海軍突擊連與地方陸軍一個排分守各島，島上留有美軍顧問。越方最高決策者是總統阮文俢，十八日晚以電報授權登陸琛航島並授權還擊開火。
countriesEn: This was a short, sharp naval clash in which two rival governments fought it out over the same chain of reefs. On the Chinese side stood the South Sea Fleet of the People's Liberation Army Navy, whose operational command actually sat at the Yulin naval base in Qiongzhong County, Hainan: on 14 January the fleet ordered the base to conduct the seventy-seventh Xisha patrol since March 1959, and on 16 January the Central Military Commission decided that all operations would be unified under the Guangzhou Military Region under commander Xu Shiyou, with a battle command group set up at Yulin. The surface task group was built around a single Type 051 guided missile destroyer, supported by Type 6604 torpedo boats, Type 6610 minesweepers, Type 037 torpedo boats and harbour craft — nineteen vessels in all and some 2,700-plus personnel by the figures usually cited in Chinese published accounts. The landing force was a reinforced battalion formed from the 150th Coastal Defence Regiment and the coastal defence zone's own amphibious reconnaissance company, while several platoons of armed militia from the Southwest China Sea Islands People's Armed Forces Department were garrisoned on Jinqing and Chenhang. On the Vietnamese side stood the Republic of Vietnam Navy's Paracel detachment, rebuilt on the hulls the Americans had handed over: HQ-5 'Tran Binh Trong' as flagship, HQ-16 'Le Dai Hanh', HQ-4 'Tran Khanh Du' and HQ-10 'Nhat Tao', plus naval assault companies and a local army platoon scattered over the islands, with American advisers on the ground. The last word belonged to President Nguyen Van Thieu, who on the evening of the eighteenth wired the flagship, authorising the landing on Chenhang Island and authorising return fire.
people: 中方的決策鏈條極短。十九日凌晨周恩來以電話指示葉劍英「立即組織領導小組，由你負責，到總參謀部指揮作戰」，並提出名單，鄧小平、陳錫聯、張春橋、王洪文、蘇振華參與；葉劍英第一個到達作戰指揮室，聽情報、調艦艇、連續下令。前方由海軍榆林基地副司令員兼參謀長魏鳴森任「海指」指揮員，乘271艇「錦州」坐鎮；獵潛第七十三大隊大隊長王克強在十六日的緊急會議上主動請纓，第七十四大隊281艇艇長李錦林、282艇艇長謝春林分別帶隊。陸戰由海南軍區司令員江雪山組成西沙基指，副司令員江海任西沙前指，十九日傍晚率參戰艦艇出航，二十日登島前登上271艇與魏鳴森合流指揮。基層的表現同樣有記錄：274艇政委馮松柏、副艇長周錫通在指揮台被四十毫米砲彈片擊中陣亡；389艦水雷兵郭玉東以身體堵住被轟開的後艙漏洞，死後仍保持堵漏姿態，被追授一等功、譽為「海上黃繼光」；登島的四連連長梁進理、黎族戰士呂亞仁，珊瑚島五連連長符之頡、兩棲偵察隊副指導員鄒妃豪與班長鍾振國均有戰功。051型那一艘的艦上指揮人員多未被公開點名，回憶史料多只以「旗艦」一詞帶過。越方與美方的人員同樣有名有姓：HQ-16艦長黎文實中校在戰後自述艦體重創經過，HQ-10艦長魏文他重傷陣亡、隨艦沉沒，一名美軍中校范文鴻在珊瑚島被俘；阮文俢的授權電報，是整場衝突的開關。
peopleEn: The Chinese chain of decision was extremely short. In the small hours of 19 January Zhou Enlai telephoned Ye Jianying with the instruction to 'immediately set up a leadership group, you will be in charge, and direct the operation from the General Staff', and he supplied the name list: Deng Xiaoping, Chen Xilian, Zhang Chunqiao, Wang Hongwen and Su Zhenhua. Ye Jianying was the first to arrive in the operations room, taking intelligence, shifting ships and issuing orders in quick succession. In the field the sea task group was commanded by Wei Mingsen, deputy commander and chief of staff of the Yulin base, who sat on the 271 boat 'Jinzhou'; the commander of the 73rd Torpedo Boat Flotilla, Wang Keqiang, volunteered at the emergency meeting of the sixteenth, and the 74th Flotilla's 281 boat captain Li Jinlin and 282 boat captain Xie Chunlin each led a team. On the land side, Jiang Xueshan, commander of the Hainan Military Region, formed the Xisha base command, with his deputy Jiang Hai as the Xisha forward command; the ships sailed in the evening of the nineteenth, and Jiang Hai came aboard the 271 boat to join Wei Mingsen before the landings of the twentieth. The conduct of the ordinary men is recorded as well: 274 boat political commissar Feng Songbai and deputy captain Zhou Xitong were killed on the bridge by fragments from a 40 mm shell; on the 389 ship, leading hand Guo Yudong plugged a hole blown open in the aft compartment with his own body and kept the position after he died, and was posthumously awarded first-class merit and praised as the 'Huang Jiguang of the sea'; among those decorated were the 4th Company commander Liang Jinli, the Li villager soldier Lü Yaren, the 5th Company commander on Sanshu Island Fu Zhixie, amphibious reconnaissance deputy instructor Zou Feihao and squad leader Zhong Zhenguo. The officers of the Type 051 that served in the group were seldom named in public; recollections refer to her mostly simply as the flagship. The Vietnamese and American side is named just as plainly: HQ-16 captain Lieutenant Commander Le Van Thuc described the severe damage to his ship after the battle, HQ-10 captain Nguyen Van Tha was mortally wounded and went down with his ship, and an American lieutenant colonel, Pham Van Hoang, was captured on Sanshu Island. The authorisation telegram from President Nguyen Van Thieu was the trigger for the whole clash.
kits: 卡面這件051型導彈驅逐艦定於一九七一年，是中國人民解放軍海軍第一型自行設計的導彈驅逐艦，也是南海艦隊水面艦隊的骨幹。按公開艦艇資料，標準排水量約二千四百噸、滿載約三千噸，艦長約一百二十八米，雙軸蒸汽輪機，最大航速約三十五節；武備為兩具雙聯裝「上游一號」反艦導彈發射架、兩門一百毫米主砲、雙聯五十七毫米與三十毫米副砲各兩座、兩座四聯二十五毫米機砲、兩座十二管二百五十毫米反潛火箭發射器、四具五百三十三毫米魚雷發射管與深水炸彈投放器，一九七四年時的雷達與射控配置仍屬早期世代，專門對空搜索能力有限。牠在這一役的位置很清楚：051型是編隊中排水量最大、航速最快，也是唯一具反艦導彈打擊手段的平臺，駐在戰場外海，負責掩護登陸兵力、監視美軍第七艦隊方向、以反艦導彈形成對大中型水面艦艇的威懾；真正咬住對方的近程炮火，交給排水量不足其五分之一的6604型獵潛艇（八十五毫米砲一門、三十七毫米砲兩門）、6610型掃雷艦（雙聯三十七毫米砲兩座、雙聯二十五毫米砲兩座）與037型獵潛艇（雙聯五十七毫米砲、雙聯三十毫米砲，另有四座五聯裝火箭深彈發射裝置與兩個深水炸彈投放器）。越方火力更重卻更老舊：HQ-5裝一百二十七毫米砲一門、四十毫米砲十門與二十毫米加農砲六門，HQ-16同樣配一百二十七毫米砲，HQ-4有自動裝彈的七十六毫米砲並以雷達瞄準，HQ-10配七十六毫米砲與兩座雙聯四十毫米砲。登島階段的裝備最原始：橡皮舟、舢板、漁輪與手搬彈藥，傷員靠漁輪後送回永興島。
kitsEn: The Type 051 guided missile destroyer shown on the card dates from 1971. It was the first guided missile destroyer designed entirely in China for the People's Liberation Army Navy and became a mainstay of the South Sea Fleet's surface force. According to published ship data, she displaced about 2,400 tons standard and some 3,000 tons full load, was about 128 metres long, and was driven by twin shafts with steam turbines for a maximum speed of roughly 35 knots. Her armament in 1974 comprised two twin launchers for the SY-1 ship-to-ship missile, two 100 mm main guns, two twin 57 mm and two twin 30 mm secondary mounts, two quadruple 25 mm automatic cannon, two twelve-tube 250 mm anti-submarine rocket launchers, four 533 mm torpedo tubes and depth charge racks, while her radar and fire control fit was still of an early generation with a dedicated air-search capability to match. Her place in this battle is quite clear. The Type 051 was by far the largest, fastest and the only platform in the group that carried a ship-to-ship missile; she lay off the battle area on the open sea, covering the landing force, watching the direction of the American Seventh Fleet and holding out a threat against large surface ships by missile. The close-range gunnery that actually grappled with the enemy was left to craft of less than a fifth of her displacement: the Type 6604 torpedo boats with one 85 mm gun and two 37 mm guns, the Type 6610 minesweepers with two twin 37 mm and two twin 25 mm mounts, and the Type 037 torpedo boats with twin 57 mm and twin 30 mm guns, four five-tube rocket depth bomb launchers and two depth charge racks. The Vietnamese ships carried heavier but older guns: HQ-5 had one 127 mm gun, ten 40 mm guns and six 20 mm cannon; HQ-16 was likewise armed with a 127 mm gun; HQ-4 had an automatic-loading 76 mm gun fired under radar control; HQ-10 had a 76 mm gun and two twin 40 mm mounts. The equipment of the landing phase was the most primitive of all — rubber boats, sampans, fishing junks and ammunition carried by hand, with the wounded ferried back to Yongxing Island aboard fishing boats.
tactics: 打響之前是長時間的海上對峙與逼近。十八日凌晨274艇突然逼近南越HQ-4至一鏈、不到半小時逼其退往珊瑚島；同日八時零五分389艦與HQ-16發生碰撞，九時零四分HQ-4後甲板機槍鳴槍兩發，雙方艦隊各自分成南北兩組在中線兩側對峙，051型旗艦在兩組之間巡弋，以雷達保持接觸，隨時可接戰或掩護撤退。十九日上午十時二十分，越方四艦展開戰鬥隊形、相背而行；十時二十三分HQ-16先以一百二十七毫米砲射擊396、389編隊，中方396艦後部三十七毫米雙聯砲隨即還擊，389艦首發命中HQ-16一部主機。271、274編隊誤把HQ-4當成旗艦，集中火力先擊中其雷達，使配備自動裝彈砲的「陳慶餘」難以瞄準開火；十一時許，越方四艦相繼受創撤離，389艦操縱失靈、十一時五十分搶灘擱淺；十二時十二分趕到的281、282艇以雙聯五十七毫米穿甲彈攻擊失去機動力的HQ-10，十二時三十分命中其彈藥庫爆炸，十四時五十二分沉沒。二十日的登島是另一套打法：九時三十分四艘護衛艇對甘泉島實施艦砲火力準備，九時五十五分四連乘橡皮舟與舢板衝灘，十時十分即占領全島；珊瑚島先由兩艘護衛艇與掃雷艦射擊，部隊在十分鐘內泅渡一千公尺登灘，攻下三層鋼筋混凝土砲樓；金銀島則以班排拉網搜索。整場戰鬥的有效射程極短，中方八十五毫米砲在三公里以外難以精確射擊，只能靠近距離直瞄；一月下旬南海正逢東北季風，浪高流急，小艇在淺礁之間的通行與射界都受影響，也正因如此，051型的大射程主砲與反艦導彈在這種近岸亂戰中反而難以發揮，牠的價值更多體現在整個編隊的士氣與對外威懾上。
tacticsEn: Before the shooting started there was a long standoff and a series of approaches at sea. In the early hours of the eighteenth the 274 boat suddenly closed on the South Vietnamese HQ-4 to within one cable, forcing her back towards Sanshu Island in less than half an hour; at 08:05 the same day the 389 ship collided with HQ-16, and at 09:04 the machine gun on HQ-4's after deck fired two rounds. The two fleets split into a northern and a southern group on either side of the midline, while the Type 051 flagship patrolled between them, holding contact with radar and ready either to engage or to cover a withdrawal. At 10:20 on the morning of the nineteenth the four Vietnamese ships spread into battle order and steamed in opposite directions; at 10:23 HQ-16 opened fire with her 127 mm gun on the 396 and 389 group, and the twin 37 mm mount at the rear of the 396 answered at once, the first salvo from the 389 striking one of HQ-16's main engines. The 271 and 274 group, believing HQ-4 to be the flagship, concentrated fire on her radar first, leaving the auto-loading guns of the 'Tran Khanh Du' unable to aim and fire. By about eleven o'clock the four Vietnamese ships had been damaged in turn and began to withdraw; the 389 lost steering and grounded at 11:50, and at 12:12 the 281 and 282 boats arrived and fired their twin 57 mm armour-piercing shells at the immobile HQ-10, hitting her magazine at 12:30 and she sank at 14:52. The landings of the twentieth were fought in a different way: at 09:30 four harbour craft gave fire support onto Ganquan Island, at 09:55 the 4th Company went ashore in rubber boats and sampans, and by 10:10 the whole island was taken. On Sanshu Island two harbour craft and a minesweeper opened fire first, the troops then swam a thousand metres and landed within ten minutes, and overran the three-storey reinforced concrete gun emplacement. On Jinyin Island the search was carried out by company and platoon in line. The effective range of the whole fight was very short: the Chinese 85 mm gun could not fire accurately beyond three kilometres and had to engage by direct aiming at close range. Late January is the height of the northeast monsoon in the South China Sea, with heavy seas and strong currents, which cramped the movement and firing arcs of the small craft among the shoals; for exactly that reason the long-range gun and the ship-to-ship missiles of the Type 051 could hardly be used in such a close coastal melee, and her value showed up instead in the morale of the whole task group and in deterrence against the outside world.
data: 數字要從雙方的紀錄裡分開看。一月二十日一役，中方以四艘直接參戰的獵潛、掃雷艦對上越方同樣四艘軍艦：越方四艦總排水量約七千八百四十噸，中方四艦合計不足兩千噸，差距約四倍半；HQ-5與HQ-16排水量達二千八百噸，HQ-4約一千五百噸，HQ-10僅六百五十噸。中方小艇方面，6604型獵潛艇標準排水量三百二十噸、航速十八節，多年服役後已退化到約十二節；6610型掃雷艦五百七十噸、十五節；037型三百七十五噸、三十節。卡面的051型標準排水量約二千四百噸、最大航速約三十五節，單艦排水量就超過中方四艘直接交戰艇艦的總和，卻在近距離炮戰中只能外圈觀察。火力參數上，八十五毫米砲射速每分鐘十五至十八發，三十七毫米砲每門三百六十至四百發，二十五毫米砲每門八百至九百發，五十七毫米砲加裝水冷後射速可達每分鐘一百二十發。按中方公開戰史常列的數字，編隊共出動艦艇十九艘、兵力約二千七百餘人，其中直接參戰四艦。傷亡與戰損：中國軍方陣亡十八人、受傷六十七人；越軍陣亡七十五人、受傷十六人、被俘四十八人（含美軍一人），中方宣稱斃傷敵軍三百餘人、擊沉一艦擊傷三艦。彈痕紀錄可核：HQ-4戰後有直徑十五厘米以上彈洞三十七個、以下四十二個、彈片擦傷七百餘處；HQ-16彈痕八百二十處、重傷傾側十五度。登島階段中方投入加強營五百餘人，民兵每排約四十人，珊瑚島守軍三十餘人、甘泉島守軍一個排，二十日共俘南越官兵四十八人。
dataEn: The numbers have to be read separately from each side's own records. In the action of 19 January the Chinese side committed four torpedo boats and minesweepers against four Vietnamese warships: the four Vietnamese ships together displaced about 7,840 tons while the four Chinese craft came to less than 2,000 tons, a difference of roughly four and a half times. HQ-5 and HQ-16 displaced 2,800 tons each, HQ-4 about 1,500 tons and HQ-10 no more than 650 tons. Among the small Chinese craft, the Type 6604 torpedo boats had a standard displacement of 320 tons and a speed of 18 knots, by then fallen back to about 12 knots after long service; the Type 6610 minesweepers were 570 tons and 15 knots; the Type 037 boats were 375 tons and 30 knots. The Type 051 on the card, at about 2,400 tons standard and some 35 knots maximum, displaced more by herself than the four Chinese craft that fought directly, and yet could only watch from the fringe in the close-range gun duel. On gun performance, the 85 mm gun fired 15 to 18 rounds a minute, each 37 mm gun 360 to 400 rounds, each 25 mm gun 800 to 900 rounds, and the water-cooled 57 mm gun could reach about 120 rounds a minute. By the figures usually quoted in Chinese published accounts, nineteen vessels and some 2,700-plus personnel took part in the operation, of which four vessels saw direct action. Casualties and damage: the Chinese side lost eighteen dead and sixty-seven wounded; the Vietnamese side seventy-five dead, sixteen wounded and forty-eight prisoners taken, including one American; the Chinese claimed over three hundred enemy casualties, one ship sunk and three damaged. The shell damage can be checked: after the action HQ-4 showed thirty-seven holes over 15 cm across, forty-two below that and more than seven hundred fragment scars; HQ-16 carried eight hundred and twenty impact marks and was listing fifteen degrees from a heavy hit. For the landings the Chinese committed a reinforced battalion of more than five hundred men, militia platoons of about forty each, while the garrison on Sanshu Island numbered a little over thirty and Ganquan Island a single platoon; on the twentieth, forty-eight South Vietnamese soldiers and officers were taken prisoner.
cause: 起因是一場漁業與主權糾纏起來的邊界對抗。一九七三年一月關於越南問題的巴黎和平協約簽定，美軍開始撤出越南並把剩餘軍艦移交南越，南越海軍元氣恢復；同年八月起，南越軍艦便在西沙海域驅趕中國漁船。一九七四年初南越政府宣布要在西沙海域勘探石油。十二月底，廣東省水產廳南海水產公司派出南漁402、407兩船共九十七人赴永樂群島羚羊礁一帶捕撈，並在琛航島架設加工廠與通信電台；一月十日漁民登甘泉島升掛國旗、豎起木牌。十一月外交部表態維權，十四日南海艦隊下令第七十七次巡邏；十五日HQ-16進永樂群島與漁船對峙、砲擊島上國旗，並放小艇載武裝海軍陸戰隊員與海關人員登船臨檢。十六日中央軍委決定由廣州軍區統一指揮並在榆林基地設作戰指揮班子，越方則在十七日由HQ-16派陸戰隊占領金銀島、HQ-4派二十七人登甘泉島取下五星紅旗插上南越國旗；十八日二十一時阮文俢復電旗艦，部署登陸琛航島並授權還擊，衝突至此再也收拾不住，兩個政權的對峙被推成了一場真刀真槍的海上交火。
causeEn: The cause was a boundary confrontation entangled with fishing and sovereignty. In January 1973 the Paris Peace Accords on Vietnam were signed, the Americans began to withdraw from Vietnam and handed their remaining warships over to South Vietnam, and the Republic of Vietnam Navy recovered its strength; from August of that year South Vietnamese ships began driving off Chinese fishing boats in the Paracel waters. In early 1974 the South Vietnamese government announced that it would survey for oil in the Paracels. In late December the South China Sea Fisheries Company of the Guangdong Provincial Department of Fisheries sent the fishing vessels Nan Yu 402 and 407, ninety-seven men in all, to fish around Lingyang Reef in the Yongle group, and set up a processing shed and a radio station on Chenhang Island; on 10 January fishermen landed on Ganquan Island, hoisted the national flag and raised a wooden marker. The Foreign Ministry spoke out in defence of the rights involved, on the fourteenth the South Sea Fleet ordered the seventy-seventh patrol, and on the fifteenth HQ-16 entered the Yongle group, confronted the fishing boats and shelled the flag on the island, then sent small boats with armed marine and customs personnel to board and inspect the fishing vessels. On the sixteenth the Central Military Commission decided to unify command under the Guangzhou Military Region and to set up an operations command group at Yulin, while the Vietnamese side on the seventeenth sent marines from HQ-16 to occupy Jinyin Island and a party of twenty-seven men from HQ-4 to land on Ganquan Island, take down the five-starred red flag and raise the flag of South Vietnam in its place. At 21:00 on the eighteenth President Nguyen Van Thieu wired the flagship, ordering the landing on Chenhang Island and authorising return fire, and from that moment the clash could no longer be contained: the standoff between two governments was pushed into a real naval engagement.
impact: 海戰之後，中華人民共和國取得對整個西沙群島及周邊海域的控制權，一九七四年下半年解放軍守備分隊進駐中建島，十月一日西沙前指撤銷、守備任務移交海軍西沙水警區，一九七五年一月守備第一百五十團守島分隊撤離歸建。對越方而言，南越在黃沙群島的實際控制與主權宣稱，後來成為北越統一越南後向國際社會提出領土要求的主要依據之一，衝突的陰影一直延到一九八八年的南沙赤瓜礁交火與二〇一二年三沙市的設立。外交層面上，美國自一九七四年一月二十一日起明確不介入：一月二十一日國務院發言人約翰·金表示不支持任何一方，基辛格同日重申並對使用武力表示遺憾，一月二十三日美中在華盛頓會談，一月二十五日美方決策層議定不介入西沙與南沙事務；南越則向聯合國安理會提出抗議，黃華代表中國指西沙是中國無可爭議的神聖領土，安理會主席賽高里達建議提交國際法院。俘虜方面，一月三十一日與二月二十七日分批在深圳經紅十字會渠道遣返。此外，這是解放軍海軍第一次在白天、遠海、深水與外國海軍交戰；一月二十二日東海艦隊增援編隊通過台灣海峽，是人民海軍水面艦艇首次通過台海。三亞紅沙的西沙海戰烈士陵園於一九七五年建成，紀念碑由南海艦隊署名。對海軍裝備而言，這一役也讓051型第一次走上海洋實戰，直接推動了八十年代反艦導彈、火控雷達與防空系統的改裝，使這型驅逐艦在後來的中越邊海對峙中成為南海艦隊遠海編隊的骨架。
impactEn: After the sea battle the People's Republic of China obtained control of the whole Paracel group and the surrounding waters. In the second half of 1974 a PLA garrison detachment took up station on Zhongjian Island; on 1 October the Xisha forward command was stood down and the guarding task handed over to the Navy's Xisha water police district; in January 1975 the island detachment of the 150th Coastal Defence Regiment withdrew and was redeployed. For the Vietnamese side, South Vietnam's actual control of the Spratly group and its claim to sovereignty later became one of the main grounds on which North Vietnam, after unifying the country, pressed territorial demands on the international community, and the shadow of the clash ran on to the Chi Gua reef incident in the Spratlys in 1988 and the establishment of the Sansha city in 2012. In diplomatic terms, the United States made clear from 21 January 1974 that it would not intervene: on the twenty-first State Department spokesman John King said the United States did not support either side, Kissinger repeated this the same day and expressed regret over the use of force, the two sides met in Washington on the twenty-third, and on the twenty-fifth the American decision-makers settled that the United States would not involve itself in the Paracels or the Spratlys. South Vietnam instead lodged a protest with the United Nations Security Council, where Huang Hua represented China and declared the Paracels inalienable sacred Chinese territory, and the Council president Sa'id al-Khalifa proposed referring the matter to the International Court of Justice. As for the prisoners of war, they were repatriated in batches at Shenzhen through the Red Cross channels on 31 January and 27 February. Beyond all this, it was the first time the PLA Navy had fought a foreign navy in daylight, on the high seas and in deep water; on 22 January a reinforcement task group of the East Sea Fleet passed through the Taiwan Strait, the first passage of PLA Navy surface ships through that strait. The Xisha naval battle martyrs' cemetery at Hongsha in Sanya was completed in 1975, its monument inscribed by the South Sea Fleet. On the equipment side, the battle also took the Type 051 out onto the open ocean for the first time, directly prompting the refits of the 1980s to her ship-to-ship missiles, fire control radar and air defence systems, and making this class of destroyer the backbone of the South Sea Fleet's long-range task groups in the later confrontation along the Sino-Vietnamese maritime frontier.
result: 一月十九日上午十時二十三分越方先開火後，戰局在半小時內分出勝負：HQ-16重傷傾側十五度、主機損壞，HQ-4的雷達與七十六毫米砲被打壞，HQ-5一百二十七毫米砲方向機受損而喪失射擊能力，HQ-10艦橋中彈起火、艦長重傷陣亡；十一時許四艦陸續撤離戰場，十二時三十分HQ-10彈藥庫被命中爆炸，十四時五十二分沉於羚羊礁以南海域。十二時十二分抵達的281、282艇接戰殘敵，十九日黃昏前中方把傷員救上漁輪送回永興島救治。二十日，中方先以艦砲對甘泉島實施火力準備，九時三十分開火、九時五十五分四連乘橡皮舟衝灘，十時十分占領甘泉島並俘敵十四人；十時三十五分珊瑚島同樣受到火力準備，兩棲偵察隊與五連攻下三層砲樓，全島守軍三十五人悉數被俘，其中一人是美軍中校范文鴻；當日下午金銀島亦被攻占。二十日夜南越「麒麟」號載一個營自峴港北上增援，走到半途擔心有去無回而折返。中方以陣亡十八人、受傷六十七人的代價，於二十日控制西沙全部島礁；越方陣亡七十五人、受傷十六人、被俘四十八人，損一艦傷三艦，南越從此放棄西沙，兩個政權在西沙的成建制對峙中斷了十四年，直到一九八八年赤瓜礁再度交火才重新面對。二月十日榆林要塞區召開祝捷慶功大會，二月二十七日最後一批南越俘虜在深圳遣返。
resultEn: Once the Vietnamese opened fire at 10:23 on the morning of 19 January, the issue was settled within half an hour: HQ-16 was badly hit, listing fifteen degrees with her main engines damaged; the radar and 76 mm guns of HQ-4 were knocked out; the train of HQ-5's 127 mm gun was damaged and the gun put out of action; and HQ-10's bridge was hit and set alight, her captain mortally wounded. By about eleven o'clock the four ships were withdrawing in turn; at 12:30 the magazine of HQ-10 was struck and blew up, and she sank at 14:52 in the waters south of Lingyang Reef. The 281 and 282 boats, which arrived at 12:12, engaged the crippled enemy, and before dusk on the nineteenth the Chinese side had the wounded put aboard a fishing boat for treatment back at Yongxing Island. On the twentieth the Chinese fired for effect on Ganquan Island: guns opened up at 09:30, the 4th Company went ashore in rubber boats at 09:55, and by 10:10 the island was taken with fourteen prisoners. Sanshu Island was shelled in the same way from 10:35, the amphibious reconnaissance company and the 5th Company overran the three-storey gun emplacement, and the whole garrison of thirty-five men was captured, one of them an American lieutenant colonel, Pham Van Hoang. Jinyin Island was also taken that afternoon. On the evening of the twentieth the South Vietnamese transport 'Lam Son' sailed north from Da Nang with a battalion of reinforcements, then turned back halfway for fear of sailing to a place from which it might not return. At a cost of eighteen dead and sixty-seven wounded, the Chinese side controlled all the islands and reefs of the Paracels by the twentieth; the Vietnamese lost seventy-five dead, sixteen wounded and forty-eight prisoners, one ship sunk and three damaged, and South Vietnam gave up the Paracels entirely, so that organised confrontation between the two governments there was interrupted for fourteen years until the fighting at Chi Gua reef in 1988 brought them face to face again. On 10 February a celebration and commendation meeting was held by the Yulin coastal defence zone, and on 27 February the last batch of South Vietnamese prisoners was repatriated at Shenzhen.
